FX-2 HOW: LIST_ROW from lg is a wrapping flex row; first child basis 14rem, last child grows from 10rem. A container of 25.5rem or more shows the old two columns; a narrower one stacks the value under its label. Below lg nothing changes.
FX-2 SPLIT: LIST_SPLIT is an auto-fit grid of at most two columns, each at least 25.5rem, so two columns need 54rem of container. Narrow splits become one column.

FX-2 WHY NOT A CONTAINER QUERY: inline-size containment collapses a list in shrink-to-fit parents, DataList.tsx is not owned, and @min-[..] goes against the canonical-breakpoint guard in recipes.test.ts.
FX-2 ERASE: ClientErasureNotices renders two prose paragraphs with a bold lead ('Kept as a record (applies).'), no DataList.
FX-2 DailyTiles.tsx: NOT edited. It already uses DetailRow; by width arithmetic its rows stack at 1280 (~200px tile), 1440 (~200px) and 1920 (~309px).

FX-7 HOW: --be-fg-faint is now rgb(38 44 54 / 68%), ink-3 at 68%; the build emits #262c36ad. A translucent token darkens with its surface, so it passes on every solid surface. A fixed grey that passes on shells, fields and tints would equal fg-muted and lose the hierarchy (DEC-45).
